purpose: Record the exact boundary for future objectives that require a qualifying action and a successful extraction in the same raid without treating legacy-looking quest flags as proven semantics.

serverSourceBoundary.finding: The pinned SPT 4.1.3 QuestController delegates quest listing/completion to QuestHelper and only creates or mutates backend task-condition counters for SellItemToTrader/HandoverItem paths. It contains no evaluator for CounterCreator kill, Equipment, ExitStatus, resetOnSessionEnd or one-session semantics.
serverSourceBoundary.implication: Server source cannot be cited as proof that a compound kill/equipment/extract CounterCreator is same-raid atomic. The unresolved authority boundary is the EFT/client quest-condition evaluator or an exact canonical vanilla objective whose behavior proves the required semantics.

removedFromAffectedOperations.armored-transit: Rejected from the active authored wave by post-010-armored-transit-vanilla-disposition.json; no same-raid proof is required for a rejected operation.

nextStaticAuthoritySearch: Exact EFT/client quest-condition evaluator semantics if a legally accessible authoritative source exists.
Exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 vanilla quest shape that combines action/equipment and Survived extraction under the same counter and has canonical one-raid behavior.
Do not substitute wiki wording or serialized flags for evaluator semantics.

futureRuntimeCheckpoint.expectedPass: A qualifying action followed by Survived extraction in the same raid completes the compound objective.
expectedFailBoundaries: A qualifying action in raid N followed by extraction in raid N+1 must not complete the objective.
Killed, MissingInAction, Runner or other disallowed exit status must not satisfy a Survived-only objective.
Progress must not leak between profiles or sessions.
